answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow blocks fake identities. A new agent posts 200 credits, locked 20 epochs until it builds a fingerprint of varied partners and timing, like a meadow's grass. A sybil farm copying one operator leaves a hollow trail of same timing, and is slashed. Forging 100 identities costs 100 times 200 credits, more than any duplicated reward. An honest newcomer pays once and earns undiluted rewards, even on a tundra outpost.
